title: テクニカルアカウントマネージャー アーキテクト - 日本
description:
テクニカルアカウントマネージャー(「TAM」)アーキテクトは、サポートサービスチームおよびサポートグループのメンバーとして、地域のサポートエンジニアリングマネージャーの配下に置かれる予定です。この新しい役職は、既存チームが一部担っている機能を遂行します。具体的には、コンサルティングサポート、エスカレーション対応の洞察、監督といった機能を、複数の顧客に対して継続的にTAM業務、コンサルティング業務、サポート業務として提供します。TAMアーキテクトはまた、エンタープライズ顧客のサポートケースにL3(サポートレベル3=エスカレーション対応)として対応します。

注:本ポジションは日本での採用となります。東京の顧客に対面でサポートを提供するための出張が発生します。

TAMアーキテクトとして成功するためには、以下の適性とアプローチが求められます:

- 高い技術力を持ち、ユーザー、顧客、見込み客に有用なソリューションを提供することに重点を置いていること

- チームメンバーおよび顧客との優れたコミュニケーション能力

- コンサルティング、サポート、プロジェクトマネジメントのスキルと経験

- 業務の50%は、戦略的ユーザー/顧客/見込み客からのケースベースのコンサルティングサポート

- 業務の50%はTAM業務(プロジェクトガイダンス、オンボーディング調整、エスカレーション対応、コミュニケーション、ドキュメント作成、ロードマップ、会議のリード)

- 現地での出張が一部必要であり、現時点では最大で業務時間の35%程度と想定されています

業務内容:

- ClickHouseセールスが特定した戦略的・エンタープライズのClickHouseユーザー、顧客、見込み客と協力し、オンボーディング、本番環境へのローンチ、POC(概念実証)に取り組む

- アーキテクチャ、技術、移行に関するガイダンスと支援を提供する

- ユーザー/顧客の継続的な成功を実現するため、プロジェクト、エスカレーション、会議をリードする

- L3サポートケースおよびエスカレーションの責任と監督を担い、サポートL1/L2チームと緊密に連携する

- ClickHouseのプロダクトマネジメント、エンジニアリング、セールスと緊密に連携し、ロードマップおよびアカウントプランの策定を支援する

- グローバルかつ分散した環境で高品質な24時間365日のサポートを提供するために必要なスケジュールおよび出張に対応し、常に対応可能な状態を維持する

- 新しいチームメンバーの採用およびメンタリングを支援する

- ドキュメント、ナレッジベース記事、ClickHouse Learning、リファレンスアーキテクチャ、QA(品質保証)ニーズの開発・支援を行う

求める経験・スキル:

- テクニカルアカウントマネジメント、プロフェッショナルサービス、シニアサポート、および/またはプロジェクトマネジメントの職務における5年以上の経験

- スケーラブルかつフォールトトレラントな分散型データベース管理システム(「DBMS」)の実装、運用、および/またはサポートにおける5年以上の関連業界経験

- DBMS、OLAP、クラウド/SaaSプラットフォーム、分散システムのソフトウェアエンジニアリング、Linux/Unix、Kubernetes、システムまたはネットワーク管理、ビッグデータなど、関連分野における広範かつ深い技術知識

- 複数の経験豊富なエンジニアと連携し、大規模な技術プロジェクトをリードし完遂した経験

- パブリッククラウドプロバイダー(AWS、GCP、Azure)およびそのIaaS(Infrastructure as a Service)サービス(例:EC2)に関する専門知識

- 優れたコミュニケーション能力、および顧客対応の役割においてサポートサービス、エンジニアリング、セールスチームと緊密に協働する能力

- チームワーク、グローバルな関与、共感、そして困難な課題を解決するマインドセット

- 地球上で最もスケーラブルで、最高性能を持ち、最大規模かつ最速のデータベースを構築することへの冒険心と当事者意識

- 自発的で、探究心があり、継続的に学び成長することに意欲的であること

訳語の確認・注記:

- TAM (Technical Account Manager) と L3 (Support Level 3) は業界標準の略称としてそのまま保持しました(日本語の技術業界でもTAM/L1・L2・L3という表記が一般的です)。

- POC は「概念実証」と補足しましたが、業界では英語表記のまま使われることも多いため、必要であれば「POC」のみに戻せます。

- IaaS も同様に、EC2の例と合わせて分かりやすくするため展開して記載しました。

- 会社名「ClickHouse」、サービス名「ClickHouse Learning」は固有名詞としてそのまま英語表記を維持しています。

必要であれば、より簡潔な社内向けトーンや、より厳密な求人サイト向けのフォーマルなトーンに調整することも可能です。

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY

title: Senior Manager, Data Product Strategy & Analytics
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

The Senior Manager, Data & Analytics Products owns a portfolio of enterprise-critical Tier 1 products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, service performance, and value realization. The role connects executive and business priorities to product roadmaps and leads across product, data engineering, analytics, governance, architecture, security, operations, and business teams.
The ideal candidate is a data and analytics leader with strong product judgment: commercially grounded, technically fluent, practical in the application of AI, and skilled at aligning senior stakeholders and global delivery teams. Success requires the ability to make enterprise data trusted, analytics products useful, and complex strategic programs executable - without requiring hands-on engineering or model development.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Tier 1 insights product portfolio strategy. Own the vision, value proposition, target users, product criticality, investment priorities, outcome metrics, and multi-horizon roadmaps for the company's most important data and analytics products. Balance run, grow, and transform priorities across the portfolio. 

• Discovery and product lifecycle. Lead stakeholder interviews, user research, decision-journey and process analysis, and opportunity sizing. Translate important business questions into product requirements, priorities, roadmaps, success measures, and an ongoing improvement agenda.

• Product reliability and performance. Define business-critical expectations for accuracy, freshness, consistency, usability, adoption, and support. Partner with Data Engineering team on availability, incident response, and technical remediation while maintaining transparent product-health reporting.

• Trusted data and governance. Establish clear ownership, shared definitions, lineage, and quality expectations for each product. Partner with Data Governance, Security, Privacy, and IT to ensure access, retention, and control requirements are appropriately addressed.

• Advanced analytics and applied AI. Identify where predictive analytics, generative AI, intelligent decision support, or automation can improve a user outcome. Shape prototypes and scalable solutions with clear evaluation measures, monitoring, explainability, controls, and human oversight.

• Executive priorities and strategic execution. Act as a trusted execution partner to senior leaders. Translate priorities into product investments, workstreams, owners, milestones, and decision forums; manage risks and dependencies; and prepare concise business cases, executive updates, and recommendations.

• Adoption and value realization. Lead launch, enablement, communications, and stakeholder engagement. Build feedback loops and measure adoption, satisfaction, decision effectiveness, productivity, revenue, cost, and risk outcomes to demonstrate and improve product value.

• Team and delivery leadership. Lead and develop product managers, analysts, and program resources while creating shared accountability across data engineering, analytics, architecture, governance, business teams, and vendors. Resolve trade-offs and sustain predictable, high-quality delivery.

Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.
A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.
CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.
Position Overview:
The Post Closing Bond Manager works directly with leaders within the Post Closing Department and supervises the Bond Post Closing Team. This role is responsible for determining when loan-level issues require escalation to senior management and ensuring that escalated matters are addressed within 48 hours. The Post Closing Bond Manager oversees the daily assignments of the Bond Post Closing Team and identifies opportunities and supports solutions to enhance operational effectiveness and department performance. • Implement process improvements that enhance efficiency in the bond loan process, including identifying, recommending, and submitting a minimum of two process improvement suggestions per month.

• Perform second-tier review of escalated files.

• Monitor staff productivity and ensure the team meets or exceeds minimum production requirements while maintaining compliance with established service level agreements (SLAs).

• Ensure timely resolution of post-closing issues related to Mortgage Credit Certificate (MCC) and bond programs.

• Interpret and implement processes for team members that are consistent with investor/Bond Agency, federal, and state requirements.

• Designate priorities based on company and branch needs and expectations.

• Oversee all loans with standalone MCCs.

• Work closely with the Training Department to develop training materials for the origination, processing, underwriting, closing, and post-closing processes related to MCC and bond programs.

• Develop and maintain condition sets for each MCC and bond program.

• Work closely with Product Development to proactively set up and develop materials for new and existing MCC and bond programs.

• Identify issues and work closely with internal CCM departments to resolve them.

• Maintain all training material related to MCC and bond programs.

• Disseminate information to the team regarding CCM initiatives, investor updates, process changes, goals, and performance.

• Develop innovative ideas to improve operations and procedures.

• Monitor defects and trends related to Bond Post Closing deficiencies and processes; create action plans for improvement.

title: Senior Executive, Client Teams
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

3120 - Senior Executive, Client Teams - GCS

The purpose of this document is to help prospective team members better understand the role and responsibilities with the position of Senior Client Executive at OpenDoor, WPP’s bespoke global operating model for Amazon and MGM Studios.

ABOUT WPP & OPENDOOR

At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.

Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon .

OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon - building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact - for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.

The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.

OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles , and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.

By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our Amazon MGM International team as a Senior Client Executive. This is a full-time position based in London. The Role will report to the Client Director. This is an incredibly exciting time to join the team, as we scale and begin to work across a fantastic and varied film slate, with titles such as Hail Mary, Verity and The Thomas Crown Affair.

This role assists in the oversight of all workstreams and helps to co-ordinate the delivery of projects from start to finish, working with our internal teams and local market colleagues to deliver excellence in execution.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Work with the OpenDoor and WPP network will be a key part of your day-to-day and enabling best practice and on-time delivery is critical.

• Build strong relationships with the local OpenDoor teams and the regional departments

• Support with socializing Global Campaign guidelines and the implementation in the market

• Collate best-in-class work across the network, elevate to regional clients, and roll out across markets

title: Senior AI Builder
description:
Senior AI Builder (Agents & Automation)
Full-time · Remote · Fintech / Prop Trading · Dubai-based group
A high-leverage hire: one strong builder delivering the output of an entire team. You own AI across the business - support, content, acquisition, operations - and turn vague business problems into systems that ship and run in production. We expect a lot and resource you accordingly.
You build, we deploy. You report directly to the founder.
What you will own
Support, near-autonomous
An agent on Intercom that reads the full knowledge base and resolves the bulk of tickets end to end, across our markets' languages, escalating the rest with context already gathered.
A content engine
Pipelines that produce, test and iterate ad creatives, landing copy, social and Reddit posts, and generated video, at the output of a full content team.
Data-driven acquisition
Agents that cross WooCommerce and Meta spend, track CPA and ROAS per country in real time, flag what to cut and what to scale, and deliver a decision brief every morning.
Permanent competitive intelligence
Monitoring of other prop firms - pricing, rules, promos, payout changes - with a daily digest.
Custom internal software
With Claude Code, real tools shipped to production - plugins, internal apps, scrapers, dashboards. No dev team required.
Multi-agent orchestration
Systems that plan, delegate to sub-agents, self-correct, and run 24/7 with memory and self-improving skills.
The bar (we hire on proof of production, not demos)

• Daily, advanced use of Claude: Claude Code, Claude Cowork, the API. Chatting with ChatGPT is not a skill.

• You have built, deployed and run AI agents in production, not one-off demos: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, custom builds or equivalent. Setup, memory, monitoring, cost control, uptime.

• You ship real software. You read, write and debug Python and JavaScript and turn an idea into a working tool without waiting on anyone.

• You know the current model landscape and when to use what: Claude Opus 4.8 / Fable 5, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3, open-weight models like Qwen. You follow releases weekly.

• End-to-end automations: n8n, Make or code, APIs, webhooks, scraping, MCP.

• AI image and video generation with the current top models: Nano Banana Pro, FLUX.2, GPT Image 2, Ideogram (image); Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Runway (video).

• You manage what breaks: hallucinations, runaway API costs, edge cases, reliability over time.

• Fluent English.

• A portfolio of real, shipped, running systems. No portfolio, no reply.

What we do not care about

• Diplomas, AI certifications, prompt engineering courses.

• We only look at what you built and what it survived in production.

What you get

• Full tools budget: Claude Max, API credits, whatever your stack needs.

• Real ownership and a direct line to the founder. You decide how things get built.

This role is not for you if

• You have only "used ChatGPT a lot."

• Your war stories are vague.

• Your projects look good in a demo but have never run in production.

• You wait to be told exactly what to do.

• You want a quiet job.

How to apply
To confirm you read this post, start your message with the word AGENT . Applications without it are not read.
Send:

• 2 or 3 systems you built and ran in production: the problem, the stack, the result, and what broke and how you handled it. Links, demos or repos required.

• In a few lines: with your first 30 days here, what AI system would you build first to create measurable business impact in a prop firm?

Process

• Shortlist

• Screen-share call

• Offer

We are an international fintech group operating several prop trading firms across our core markets, headquartered in Dubai and scaling internationally. The business is growing fast, and AI is central to how we operate and scale.

Strategic Specialty Leadership

• Serve as a clinical leader supporting the growth of Nova Scotia’s virtual care presence.

• Liaise with Nova Scotia health authorities, organizations, and partners as appropriate.

• Provide input on Nova Scotia-specific product needs, regulatory considerations, and physician experience improvements.

MD LEAD RESPONSIBILITIES (CROSS-PROVINCIAL)

• Attend and contribute to MD Roundtable meetings.

• Support initial onboarding of new physicians across provinces as needed.

Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.

Our small but growing distributed team includes more than 65 people across seven countries. Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s applications freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!
 
E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of space-powered Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. The Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for the accurate, timely, and complete processing, reconciliation, and reporting of accounts receivable activity. The role independently manages key receivable processes, resolves complex payment and account issues, supports the monthly close, and serves as a knowledgeable resource for internal and external stakeholders on accounts receivable matters. title: Software Engineering Manager, Database (SmithDB)
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the team

SmithDB is LangChain's internal database team. We're building a storage and query layer purpose-built for AI observability and evaluation. Within six months we went from idea to a production system that offers industry leading performance and scalability for agent observability data. We're a small, fast team of systems engineers tackling genuinely hard problems: storage layout, query execution, compaction, and scaling toward trillions of agent traces. We develop in Rust, run on Kubernetes, and integrate tightly with S3/GCS/Azure Blob. There are no legacy constraints; this is a greenfield system with real production load and ambitious engineering goals.

 

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead the SmithDB team. This is not a pure people-management role. You'll write production code, review PRs at the systems level, make architectural calls, and be in the weeds alongside your engineers. At the same time, you'll own team health, hiring, technical roadmap, and coordination with the broader LangSmith platform. The ideal candidate has deep systems or database engineering experience and genuinely prefers to stay technical while growing a team.

 

What you'll do

- Write and review production Rust code across ingestion, query execution, and storage layers

- Lead architectural decisions on storage format, compaction, indexing, and query planning

- Drive performance investigations using memory and CPU profiling tools; own the path from profiling to shipped fix

- Design and harden the distributed deployment of SmithDB services on Kubernetes (multi-tenant, high-throughput, low-latency)

- Contribute to cloud object store integrations (S3, GCS, Azure Blob) and set the standard for how SmithDB manages data at rest and in flight

- Build and maintain observability for the engine itself: metrics, tracing, debug tooling

- Manage a small but growing team of systems engineers: set goals, run 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and grow careers

- Own the SmithDB technical roadmap in partnership with LangSmith product and engineering leadership

- Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to the broader organization: you write concise, decision-ready updates

 

What you'll bring

- 7+ years in systems or database engineering, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or engineering management role

- Production Rust experience - you can write it, review it, and have opinions on how to structure it at scale

- Deep understanding of database or storage engine internals: query execution, storage layouts, indexing, compaction

- Proficiency in systems performance analysis: memory allocators

title: Power Controls Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is seeking an experienced Power Controls Engineer to develop and implement advanced control algorithms for high-performance power electronic systems. We're looking for someone with deep expertise in control system modeling and simulation - particularly in Simulink and PLECS - who can take a controls concept from simulation through hardware validation. This individual will own the control architecture for DC/DC converters, inverters, and motor drives built around discrete SiC and GaN power stages, and will work closely with power hardware and firmware engineers to deliver tightly integrated, high-reliability systems for defense and aerospace applications.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Design, simulate, and validate closed-loop control algorithms for switch-mode power converters and inverters using Simulink and/or PLECS.

• Controls for 3-phase AC systems, with and without a switched Neutral

• Develop plant models and controller architectures (voltage-mode, current-mode, sensorless FOC, etc.) for multi-kW power stages utilizing discrete SiC and GaN FETs.

• Perform stability analysis, loop shaping, and compensator design to meet transient response, efficiency, and EMI targets.

• Collaborate with power hardware engineers on gate drive tuning, dead-time optimization, and switching-loss characterization of wide-bandgap devices.

• Support model-based code generation workflows and work with firmware engineers to translate control designs into embedded implementations.

• Define and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and power-hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) test plans to validate control performance against system requirements.

• Contribute to trade studies on converter topology, modulation strategy, and control bandwidth as they relate to size, weight, power, and thermal constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience designing and tuning digital control loops for power electronic converters (DC/DC, DC/AC, or motor drives).

• Proficiency in Simulink and/or PLECS for control system modeling, simulation, and analysis.

• Strong foundation in control theory - z-domain and s-domain design, bode analysis, state-space methods, and discrete-time implementation considerations.

• Hands-on experience with discrete SiC and/or GaN FET-based power stages in the multi-kW range.

• Familiarity with military or aerospace environments and standards such as MIL-STD-461, 464, 810, or DO-160.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• MS/PhD with a focus in power electronics controls or control systems.

• Experience writing embedded firmware (C/C++) for microcontrollers or DSPs used in power converter control (e.g., TI C2000, STM32).

• Familiarity with auto-code generation from Simulink (Embedded Coder) or similar model-based design toolchains.

• Experience with real-time HIL platforms (e.g., Typhoon HIL, dSPACE, OPAL-RT).

• Knowledge of advanced modulation techniques (SVM, DPWM) and their impact on switching losses in wide-bandgap devices.

• Design-for-Reliability practices including DFMEA.

• Experience with EMI mitigation strategies at the controls and layout level.

title: (Senior) Social Media Manager (m/w/d) - Remote (Deutschlandweit)
description:
Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 600.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!
📌 Deine Mission
Als (Senior) Social Media Manager (m/w/d) treibst du die strategische Weiterentwicklung und Skalierung der organischen Social-Media-Präsenz von NextLotto über Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn und weitere Kanäle voran und entwickelst Social Media zu einem echten Wachstums- und Markenhebel. Gemeinsam mit unserem Social Media Manager verantwortest du Strategie, Programme und Content-Rhythmus. Mit Fokus auf unser Wachstum skalierst du die Nutzerbasis des Lotto Scanners, stärkst gezielt Markenmomente, steigerst messbar App-Installationen und Tipp-Team-Beitritte und entwickelst passive Zielgruppen zu aktiven Community-Mitgliedern.
🎯 Deine Aufgaben

• Du verantwortest den Content-Plan für Instagram, TikTok und LinkedIn - von Planung über Briefing bis zur Veröffentlichung.

• Du briefst und koordinierst unser Creative Team, Motion, Marketing-Kolleg:innen sowie weitere Stakeholder.

• Du managst unsere Community skalierbar und interagierst aktiv mit Kommentaren, DMs und User Generated Content.

• Du steuerst Influencer- und UGC-Kooperationen end-to-end - von der Auswahl über Briefing und Content-Review bis zum Performance-Tracking.

• Du koordinierst Paid-Social-Storytelling gemeinsam mit dem UA Manager und stellst die Abstimmung zwischen organischen und bezahlten Maßnahmen sicher (ohne direkte Paid-Verantwortung).

• Du misst und berichtest wöchentlich sowie monatlich relevante Social KPIs - Reichweite, Engagement, Follower-Wachstum sowie App-Install- und Tipp-Team-Attribution.

• Du arbeitest eng mit Legal zusammen und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen (insb. GlüStV, GGL)) sicher, ohne kreative Ansätze einzuschränken.

• Du bist bei wichtigen Brand-Aktivierungen vor Ort , um Content zu erstellen und maximale Aufmerksamkeit zu generieren.

• Du identifizierst und testest neue Kanäle wie Pinterest, Reddit und weitere .

🚀 Deine Kompetenzen
Must-have:

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Social Media Management , davon idealerweise 3+ Jahre mit Kanalverantwortung für eine deutsche B2C-Consumer-Brand.

• Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Generierung messbarer App-Installationen bzw. Nutzerakquise über organische und Influencer-getriebene Maßnahmen - nicht nur Reichweite.

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Influencer- und Creator-Kooperationen mit klar messbaren Ergebnissen.

• Nachweisbares Wachstum organischer Kanäle (Portfolio / Case Studies erforderlich).

• Fundierte Plattform-Expertise in mindestens zwei der Kanäle: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn .

• Analytische Stärke in der Interpretation von Engagement-, Attributions- und Conversion-Daten sowie im Aufbau aussagekräftiger Dashboards.

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Creative-Teams (Video, Design, Copy).

• Praktische Erfahrung im Videoschnitt (z. B. CapCut, Premiere, grundlegende After Effects Kenntnisse).

• Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift inkl. ausgeprägter Copywriting-Skills .

Nice-to-have:

• Erfahrung im Skalieren einer deutschen Consumer-App-Brand über Social Media .

• Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen (z. B. Lotterie, Fintech, Glücksspiel, Gaming) .

• Entwicklung skalierbarer Content-Frameworks oder redaktioneller Workflows.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Paid-Social-Teams, insbesondere bei Creative Testing und Insights-Transfer.

• Vertrautheit mit Social Listening- und Scheduling-Tools (z. B. Sprout, Hootsuite, Iconosquare, Later) .

• Grundlegendes Verständnis von Paid Social (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager) .

• Idealerweise Background in Sport, Motorsport, Lifestyle, Fintech oder App-Brands.

• Kenntnisse gängiger Growth-Frameworks (MMM, Attribution, Incrementality) .

• Erfahrung mit Deep Linking und Social Attribution (z. B. Adjust, AppsFlyer, Branch) .

💡Softskills

• Ownership-Mindset - setzt eigenständig Richtung

title: Animator – Video Content & Ad Creatives (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Job Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time (8:00 AM - 6:00 PM)
About Us:
We are an innovative and forward-thinking company dedicated to delivering high-quality, engaging content. We are currently seeking a skilled and experienced Videographer to join our remote team. In this role, you will create dynamic video content and ad creatives using stock images, footage, and AI-powered tools. If you're passionate about visual storytelling and working with the latest tools to enhance your creative process, we want to hear from you!
Position Overview:
As a Videographer, you will be responsible for producing high-quality videos and ad creatives that capture our brand's essence and communicate our message effectively. Working remotely, you’ll use stock images, video footage, and AI tools to deliver polished video content for various marketing channels. You will collaborate closely with the marketing and creative teams to meet deadlines and bring compelling visual ideas to life.
Key Responsibilities:

• Plan, shoot, edit, and produce high-quality video content for marketing campaigns, digital ads, social media platforms, websites, and more.

• Use stock images, video footage, and AI tools to create engaging ad creatives aligned with brand guidelines.

• Work closely with the creative and marketing teams to brainstorm, conceptualize, and execute video content that appeals to target audiences.

• Optimize video content for various platforms, such as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok, ensuring each video meets the required format and specifications.

• Edit and post-produce video content using industry-standard software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro) and AI-based tools.

• Source and select appropriate stock footage, images, music, and effects to enhance storytelling and visual appeal.

• Maintain an organized library of assets, project files, and completed video content.

• Stay up to date with the latest video production trends, AI tools, and technologies to improve efficiency and creativity in the production process.

Qualifications:

• Proven experience as a videographer, video editor, or similar role, with a portfolio showcasing video content and ad creatives.

• Proficiency in video production software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, veed.io).

• Familiarity with AI tools for video creation and editing (e.g., AI video generators, AI-assisted editing software).

• Experience with stock libraries (e.g., Shutterstock, Adobe Stock, Envato) for sourcing assets.

• Strong understanding of video formats, aspect ratios, and optimizations for social media and digital advertising platforms.

• Creative mindset with an eye for detail and visual storytelling.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• A strong passion for exploring new video production trends and technologies.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in 2D/3D animation or motion graphics.

• Basic knowledge of graphic design software (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator).

• Experience creating video ads for eCommerce, social media, or brand campaigns.

Why Join Us:

• Fully remote position with a flexible work environment.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Opportunity to work with an innovative, creative, and supportive team.

• Work on exciting projects and use cutting-edge AI tools to create unique video content.

How to Apply:
Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a cover letter outlining your experience and why you are a great fit for the role. In your portfolio, include examples of video content and ad creatives using stock assets and AI tools.
We look forward to reviewing your application and exploring how you can contribute to our team!

description:

Location: Remote.Candidates must be available during U.S. Pacific business hours and possess excellent spoken and written English.

Help Great Salespeople Become Elite

About TurFresh

TurFresh is the original and most established artificial turf cleaning and maintenance company, serving homeowners and businesses across multiple states.

For over 26 years, we’ve focused on creating cleaner, safer, more enjoyable outdoor spaces while building lasting customer relationships. Every interaction, from the first call to ongoing service, is designed to earn trust and deliver long-term value.

We continuously improve how we sell, coach, operate, and serve by embracing AI, testing new ideas, and holding ourselves accountable. We value curiosity and a commitment to getting better every week.

Through our TurfRescue initiative, we make regular donations to animal shelters and rescues, supporting the care of dogs and helping the organizations that protect and rehome them.

Our sales team isn’t broken.

They’re successful, highly coachable, and committed to continuous improvement. They voluntarily attend weekly training, embrace feedback, and actively seek coaching because they want to become exceptional at their craft.

We’re looking for someone who shares that mindset.

Your Mission

Improve our inbound sales team’s conversion rate.

Everything else, including coaching, accountability, role-playing, call reviews, AI insights, training reinforcement, and performance management, exists to accomplish that goal.

About the Opportunity

This role begins as an Initial 90-Day Performance Engagement because we believe leadership should be demonstrated through results, not resumes or titles.

At the end of the engagement, the question should be simple:

Did our sales team improve because you were here?

If the answer is yes, we’ll want to continue building together in a long-term leadership role.

Our Sales Model

Our business is different from most home service companies.

• Every customer begins as an inbound inquiry.

• Customers have already expressed interest before speaking with our team.

• Sales consultants educate, qualify, quote, and close customers entirely over the phone.

• Field technicians verify measurements and perform the work. They do not sell.

• Marketing generates demand. Sales converts demand.

We are not trying to generate more leads.

We are focused on converting more of the opportunities we already earn.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

TurFresh has been in business for more than 26 years, but we don’t operate like a company that’s satisfied with the status quo.

We’re constantly refining how we sell through AI, call analysis, operational feedback, experimentation, evolving sales playbooks, and continuous learning.

You’ll join a company that already has a strong operating foundation, including:

• AI-assisted call analysis

• Weekly coaching reports

• CRM dashboards

• Sales scorecards

• Standard operating procedures

• Structured onboarding

• Weekly sales workshops

• KPI reporting

We don’t expect you to arrive with a canned methodology.

We expect you to learn our business quickly, contribute ideas, reinforce what works, challenge what doesn’t, and help us continuously improve how we coach and how we sell.

What You’ll Do

You will:

• Own the daily performance of our inbound sales team.

• Coach sales consultants through structured one-on-one coaching.

• Reinforce and expand on concepts taught during weekly sales workshops.

• Review recorded sales conversations and AI-generated coaching insights.

• Conduct role-play sessions using real customer scenarios.

• Inspect execution to ensure coaching becomes a daily habit.

• Hold salespeople accountable for consistently executing our sales methodology.

Trendyol’da Sizi Neler Bekliyor?
- FlexBenefits: Günlük yemek bütçeni özelleştirebilir, sağlık sigortanı upgrade edebilir, akaryakıt desteği veya Trendyol alışveriş bakiyesi gibi ek haklar arasından ihtiyacına göre seçim yapabilirsin.
- İyi yaşam desteği: Lokasyon bazlı kurum içi doktorlarımızdan, psikolog ve diyetisyen desteğinden ve HPV aşısı kapsamından faydalanabilirsin.
- Kişiselleştirilmiş öğrenme ve gelişim fırsatları: Yıllık eğitim bütçeni ihtiyacana uygun olduğunu düşündüğün eğitim veya konferans için kullanabilirsin. LMS platformumuzdan dilediğin an faydalanabilir, yıl boyu sunulan yüz yüze eğitimlere katılabilirsin.

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, Domain Enablement (R5536)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI ’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
Job Description:

The Senior Data & Analytics Engineer is a hybrid builder role focused on enabling business domains onto the Databricks platform by developing governed Silver and Gold assets, reusable semantic patterns, and domain-ready analytical models. This role sits between pure data engineering and pure analytics engineering: it requires enough technical depth to work comfortably with transformations and lakehouse patterns, and enough business fluency to build trustworthy models that business stakeholders can use and extend.

Initial focus for this role is expected to be G&A and GTM-oriented domains such as Accounting, Program Finance, RevOps, Marketing, HR, and adjacent business functions, while remaining flexible enough to support more complex future domains such as Product or Engineering as the team matures. This role is not a dashboard factory; it is responsible for durable, governed datasets and semantic assets that accelerate domain self-service while maintaining enterprise consistency.

What you'll do:

• Build and maintain Silver and Gold data models, domain marts, curated datasets, and semantic assets for priority domains onboarding to Databricks.

• Partner directly with business stakeholders to translate domain requirements and KPI definitions into governed, testable, and reusable transformation logic.

• Apply enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, semantic definitions, and promotion rules, contributing practical improvements back into those standards.

• Create reusable domain patterns and analytical building blocks that allow teams such as FP&A, RevOps, and Marketing to operate more self-service over time.

• Support the design of semantic views and curated layers that can be consumed by BI tools, Databricks SQL, and Genie or related AI/BI experiences.

• Work across domain boundaries when metrics overlap or interact, especially where G&A, GTM, workforce, and product-adjacent concepts intersect.

• Ensure data sensitivity, classification, and approved use are reflected in modeling choices, joins, and semantic exposure, particularly for regulated or restricted datasets.

• Review and refine partner-delivered or domain-contributed data models to ensure they are production-worthy, understandable, and aligned with enterprise definitions.

• Help domain teams grow into more self-service analytics by providing patterns, documentation, examples, and technical guidance rather than permanently centralizing every request.

Required qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, data engineering, or a hybrid role spanning modeling and transformation work.

• Strong dimensional modeling and semantic design skills, including facts, dimensions, grain, conformed dimensions, and business-friendly analytical structures.

• Strong SQL skills and comfort working with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks.

• Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into precise, auditable, and reusable data models.

• Enough data engineering fluency to work comfortably in Silver-to-Gold transformations, testing, performance tuning, and production deployment contexts.

• Ability to understand the business meaning and usage constraints of the data being modeled, not just the technical transformations involved.

• Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with business stakeholders in domains with evolving definitions and priorities.

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
About Team

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and advancing toward AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world environments. Working across the full model and systems stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the physical constraints of real-world systems to improve people’s lives.

About Role

We’re looking for a Procurement Coordinator to support the day-to-day purchasing and logistics needs of our Robotics organization. You’ll follow up on orders, coordinate domestic and international shipments, work with suppliers and logistics providers, and keep the details organized from purchase request through delivery.

This is an entry-level position for someone who is organized, curious, and eager to take ownership. You don’t need years of procurement experience, but you should be comfortable asking questions, learning quickly, and following through. When an email goes unanswered, you pick up the phone. When a delivery is at risk, you find out why, identify the next step, and keep the right people informed.

You’ll also help improve how we work. We expect you to adopt AI tools and build practical automations that reduce repetitive tasks, improve visibility, and make the supply chain team more effective. This role offers an opportunity to build a foundation in procurement, logistics, and hardware operations.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA and requires in-person presence 4 days a week and up to 10% travel to vendor sites.

In this role you will:

- Follow up with internal teams to keep purchase requests and PO issuance moving on time, resolve missing information, and confirm that suppliers receive and acknowledge orders.

- Track open orders through delivery, maintain accurate supplier commitments, and proactively follow up on lead times, shipment dates, and overdue items.

- Coordinate domestic and international logistics, including scheduling couriers, arranging pickups, booking shipments, tracking deliveries, and resolving shipping exceptions.

- Prepare and check commercial invoices, packing lists, and other shipping documentation. Work with suppliers, customs brokers, and internal specialists to address customs questions and support timely clearance.

- Manage day-to-day coordination with third-party logistics providers (3PLs), including receiving, storage, outbound shipments, and resolving inventory or delivery discrepancies.

- Keep purchasing and logistics records current, communicate clear status updates, and help resolve order discrepancies, returns, and missing delivery documentation.

- Use AI, spreadsheets, and workflow automation tools to streamline order tracking, follow-up reminders, shipment updates, and routine reporting. Check that the resulting information is accurate and useful.

- Support the broader supply chain team as priorities shift. Take action on open issues, call suppliers when email isn’t working, and escalate risks early with clear context and proposed next steps.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Are starting your career and want to build experience in procurement, logistics, or operations. Relevant experience can come from internships, school projects, part-time work, or other roles where you managed details and followed through.

- Are highly organized and attentive to detail. You can keep track of multiple orders, deadlines, and follow-ups without losing sight of what matters most.

- Have a bias for action. You’re comfortable contacting an unfamiliar supplier, asking direct questions, and following up persistently and professionally.

- Communicate clearly and close the loop. People know what’s happening, what’s blocked, and what you’re doing next.

- Are comfortable with spreadsheets and learning new systems. You actively experiment with AI tools and can turn a repetitive task into a more reliable workflow.

- Adapt well

description:

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private, and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.

To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. Our U.S. Consular Services team supports corporate clients and their employees with business visa and consular service needs. As a Senior Associate, you will manage business visa and consular matters from initial assessment through completion, providing thoughtful, consultative guidance and exceptional client service throughout the process. You will work closely with clients, embassies and consulates, global colleagues, and external service providers to support successful case outcomes.

• Serve as a point of contact for clients, providing timely updates, issue resolution, and proactive guidance throughout the case lifecycle.

• Partner with Vialto colleagues globally to support cross-border business visa and consular services.

• Maintain accurate case records and adhere to Vialto quality standards and operational procedures.

• Support larger client projects and contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.

• Contribute to client advisory discussions and help strengthen long-term client relationships through a consultative service approach.

Required Qualifications

• 3-6 years of directly relevant business visa experience.

• Hands-on experience preparing and managing business visa applications.

• Strong case management experience supporting matters from initiation through completion.

• Experience coordinating visa appointments and managing consular processing requirements.

• Experience liaising directly with embassies and consulates in support of business visa and consular matters.

• Strong understanding of corporate business visa processes and outbound travel authorization requirements.

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong client service orientation and relationship management capabilities.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams.

• High attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills.

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About Us
Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
 
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies - including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
 
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com.

Role Summary
The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for driving renewals, upselling, and cross selling within a portfolio of existing enterprise customers (1,001+ users).  Acting as a trusted advisor, this role focuses on understanding customer business and security needs, influencing key stakeholders, and aligning Sophos solutions to maximize customer retention, expand adoption, and drive long-term account value through disciplined enterprise account management. 
The role operates in complex enterprise environments, requiring engagement with multiple stakeholders, coordination across internal teams and partners, and navigation of formal procurement and contracting processes. Success is driven by deep customer understanding, proactive planning, and the ability to identify and close expansion opportunities while ensuring timely and successful renewals. 
This role is ideal for enterprise sellers who excel at long‑term account ownership, consultative selling, and delivering sustained value within large, complex organizations. 

In the United States, the base salary for this role ranges from $127,500 to $212,500. In addition to the base salary, there's a component for target sales commissions alongside a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 
 
The ideal candidate should reside in one of the following areas: San Francisco Bay area, Phoenix, or Las Vegas.

- Strong C++ and Python.

Desirable
